verdict.rationale: Community evidence from the Gemini CLI launch thread confirms an official Gemini CLI exists and works on large codebases (gemini-comm-13). One user reports it failed to log in with a Workspace account, blocking their work use (gemini-comm-15). No first-party docs in the pack describe the CLI, so its scope and installation are unverified; missing for 10: first-party CLI documentation, evidence of setup and commands, evidence of agentic or scripting capabilities, and Workspace/enterprise account support.
